specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_exclusions: Không tạo picking engine thứ hai; GUI toggle Matrix thuộc 03.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Osnap Tangent Perpendicular” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: each operation changes only its documented state and supports undo/cancel where applicable.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M02: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Osnap Tangent Perpendicular”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

proposed_fixture.algorithm_and_coverage: Dùng curve derivative/normal, kiểm tra dot-product và candidate branch; không đoán cho BRep unsupported
proposed_fixture.tolerance_policy: Use document absolute tolerance of M01; do not guess at source pin; pixel threshold calibrated for DPR.

runtime_implementation.scope: Tangent points use the two real branches from an external reference point; perpendicular uses the centre/reference radial line. Inside points yield no tangent.
remaining: Manual M02-UI review pending; no human sign-off is claimed.

standalone_verification_2026_10_22.acceptance: An external point yields real tangent/perpendicular branches; a point at/inside the circle reports no fake tangent.

directional_nurbs_commit_2026_11_18.scope: Viewport one-shots and SDK queries both require the previous point. On one rotated and nonuniformly scaled quadratic NURBS, both modes verify source membership and tangent or perpendicular residuals, then commit the returned point through the normal transaction path.

source_rim_directional_snap_2026_11_19.scope: The viewport selects the top circular edge of a canonical BRep cylinder. The exact native knot trim fixes the Perpendicular refusal. Tangent and Perpendicular each commit the source witness and undo correctly in Wireframe and Shaded.

source_knot_trim_both_directions_2026_11.scope: A nonperiodic NURBS trim without a seam override keeps the exact original native knot for each cut, including curves traversed in reverse. Four cuts on a rational circle check the source evaluation, direction and control points on both sides of the knot.

bounded_segment_perp_2026_11_18.scope: The projection rejects perpendicular feet outside the finite segment. The viewport keeps Perp armed after a miss and commits a valid elevated source foot with one Undo entry and complete Undo and Redo.

snaps_menu_audit_2026_11_17.qualification: Historical technical_scope_complete is limited to its recorded fixtures; it is not current whole-menu acceptance
